Our approach introduces path-centric reward shaping for agentic RAG training, comprising: (1) Dual-Track Path Scoring that evaluates trajectories from both self-consistency and reference-alignment perspectives, and (2) Soft Outcome Scoring that extracts training signals even from incorrect answers.
